source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 355 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-355.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 355 was established by Ordinance No. 20999, passed by the Dallas City Council on June 26, 1991. Ordinance No. 20999 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 20999; 25850)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-355.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 355 is established on property generally located along the south line of Stemmons Freeway, east of the most northeasterly end of a cornerclip at the intersection of the south line of Stemmons Freeway and the east line of Market Center Boulevard. The size of PD 355 is approximately 6.319 acres. (Ord. Nos. 20999; 25850)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-355.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A. (Ord. Nos. 20999; 25850)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-355.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 355A). (Ord. Nos. 20999; 25850)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-355.105. USES.

The only uses permitted on the Property are as follows:

(1) A private stable.

(2) Commercial amusement (inside).

(3) All other uses permitted in the MU-3 Mixed Use District, subject to the same conditions applicable in the MU-3 Mixed Use District. For example, a use only allowed in the MU-3 Mixed Use District by specific use permit (SUP) is only allowed in this PD by SUP; a use subject to development impact review (DIR) in the MU-3 Mixed Use District is subject to DIR in this PD; etc. (Ord. Nos. 20999; 25850)

sections.title: Development Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-355.106. DEVELOPMENT STANDARDS.

Development of the Property must comply with the yard, lot, and space regulations for the MU-3 Mixed Use District contained in Chapter 51A. (Ord. Nos. 20999; 25850)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-355.107. OFF-STREET PARKING.

Parking for the commercial amusement (inside) use developed as an equestrian arena must be provided at a ratio of one parking space per 1,000 square feet of arena area. Parking for all other uses must comply with Chapter 51A. (Ord. Nos. 20999; 25850)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-355.108. SIGNS.

All signs must comply with the provisions for business zoning districts contained in Chapter 51A. (Ord. Nos. 20999; 25850)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-355.109. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

Use of the Property must comply with all applicable federal and state laws and regulations, and with all applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 20999; 25850)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-355.110. PAVING.

All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 20999; 25850)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-355.111. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, Chapter 51A, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 20999; 25850)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-355.112. ZONING MAP.

PD 355 is located on Zoning Map Nos. I-6 and I-7. (Ord. Nos. 20999; 25850)
